title: Hot CPI Data Crushes Markets, Inflation Jumps As Stocks, Gold, Silver And Bitcoin Flush, Oil Rallies
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: Headline 3.7% y/y vs 3.6% forecast and both core readings 0.1 hotter; inflation is embedded beyond oil and gas.
Hot CPI plus high oil may force the Fed to raise in October or December; markets dislike higher rates with higher oil.
Chip stocks sell even on great earnings (ASML, Micron) as institutions unload oversized positions, signalling a late stage of the AI/semis cycle.
Conflicts (Houthis, Iran, Ukraine) mean massive future demand for drones; discounted drone makers are attractive.
